notes.title: Crit Happens! Has Been Selected For Tiny Teams 2025!
notes.content: [p][i]Crit Happens![/i] has been selected to feature in [b]Tiny Teams 2025[/b], alongside a host of other games![/p][p][/p][p]Keep an eye out for potential streamer coverage of [i]Crit Happens![/i] over on [b]Twitch[/b] and [b]YouTube[/b]![/p][p][/p][p]Also, checkout the other games taking part in Tiny Teams 2025 - [url="https://store.steampowered.com/sale/TinyTeams2025"]https://store.steampowered.com/sale/TinyTeams2025[/url][/p]
